query: UPDATE app.address SET label = $3, recipient_name = $4, recipient_phone = $5, address_line = $6, province_name = $7, city_name = $8, postal_code = $9, notes = $10, time_zone = $11, is_default = $12, updated_at = now(), updated_by = $13 WHERE id = $1 AND patient_id = $2 AND deleted_at IS NULL
